name: Trip Board
pitch: A trip planner to replace the spreadsheet: drag days, places and hotels around, and pin what's certain.
problem: Trip spreadsheets need retyping every time the days move.

stats.label: cards of things a first visit shouldn't miss

features.title: Days, cities, beds
features.text: Mark where you are each day, and the hotels line up night by night.
details: Every day follows along until the next change
Hotels count nights, and flag a night with no bed
Pencil things in, then pin them once they're certain

screen.alt: The trip overview: Beijing four days, Suzhou two, Shanghai two, with three hotels lined up underneath and one night still unbooked

features.title: Swipe what to see
features.text: A deck per city of the things a first visit would regret missing.
details: Must do, optional, later or not for me
Each card says how long to allow and how much walking
What you keep is grouped by area into days

screen.alt: A Discover card for Beijing: A hutong on foot with no destination, two hours, easy walking, with buttons for not for me, optional, later and must do

features.title: Am I seeing enough?
features.text: Coverage maps lay every planned day over the last, city by city.
details: Spot days that cover the same ground twice

features.title: Goes where you go
features.text: Link a file once and your trips follow you through Dropbox or iCloud.
details: Any city off the list gets a deck from OpenStreetMap
While you're away, Today shows what's on and tonight's bed

screens.alt: Trip Board's calendar for an eight-day sample trip from Beijing to Shanghai: the overview, hotels, your magnets and the Discover decks
screens.caption: The sample trip: eight days, three cities
